explanations: The value check uses the global isFinite(), which coerces its argument to a number first: isFinite("21.5"), isFinite(null), isFinite("") and isFinite(true) all return true. The range check that follows also coerces, so quoted and null readings pass validation and are stored as-is. Downstream, hourlyAverages() then concatenates strings (0 + "23" is "023") and counts null as 0. The fix requires typeof value === "number" and uses Number.isFinite, which never coerces, so anything that isn't a real finite JSON number is rejected with a 400.
